primary_title: Up-regulation of N-cadherin by Collagen I-activated Discoidin Domain Receptor 1 in Pancreatic Cancer Requires the Adaptor Molecule Shc1
decision_basis: DDR1b pY513-dependent SHC1 PTB docking is supported by collagen-I rescue/mutant and Shc1-depletion assays with bounded JNK1/N-cadherin output.
limitations_preserved: Preserve DDR1b isoform, pY513, collagen-I pancreatic-cancer context, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Discoidin domain receptor 2 interacts with Src and Shc following its activation by type I collagen
decision_basis: Collagen-I-stimulated DDR2 associates with SHC1 in a Src-dependent receptor-proximal system with receptor phosphorylation and bounded MMP2 readout.
limitations_preserved: Preserve fibrillar collagen-I, Src dependence and no site-specific docking or SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Phosphotyrosine mediated protein interactions of the discoidin domain receptor 1
decision_basis: DDR1 pY881-to-PIK3R1/p85 recruitment is supported by direct phosphopeptide pull-down, competition and quantitative proteomic mapping.
limitations_preserved: Preserve site-specific biochemical recruitment; no exclusive ligand-dependent activation, SCI or terminal-TF claim.

primary_title: Phosphotyrosine mediated protein interactions of the discoidin domain receptor 1
decision_basis: DDR1 pY740-to-INPP5D/SHIP1 recruitment is supported by direct pY740 phosphopeptide pull-down, competition and proteomic mapping as a bounded inhibitory branch.
limitations_preserved: Preserve pY740 and inhibitory SHIP1 semantics; no whole-cell collagen-specific loss-of-function, SCI or terminal-TF claim.
